grades.lower_bound_mechanism: tree-pairing on rank pairs + signed subset-sum (2-color a tree component, geometric signed sum >= u)
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: subset-sum pigeonhole gap <= 1/(2^(n+1)-1) + overlay/cross-pairing cuts leaving equal pairs plus leftover of total <= u
grades.notes: Complete self-contained proof. Lemma 2 proves the picking reduction by induction (greedy optimal both sides); Lemma 4 gives the all-n lower bound via a tree-component 2-coloring argument; Lemma 5 gives the all-n upper bound with an explicit <=n-cut construction, edge cases handled. Numerical checks are supplementary only.
